planets.name: Kepler-90 i
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 14.4-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: Kepler-90 i was found in 2017 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Shallue & Vanderburg 2018's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SHALLUE__AMP__VANDERBURG_2018): disc_year 2017, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 8; pl_orbper 14.44912, pl_radj 0.11776251, pl_bmassj 0.00724

quotes.title: Kepler-90i
quotes.card: Kepler-90i (also known by its Kepler Object of Interest designation KOI-351.08) is a super-Earth exoplanet with a radius 1.32 times that of Earth, orbiting the early G-type main sequence star Kepler-90 every 14.45 days, discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 2,840 light-years (870 parsecs, or nearly 2.4078×1016 km) from Earth in the constellation Draco.
